summary: US Central Command destroyed 10 Iranian tankers over the past week in response to IRGC ballistic missile attacks on American warships, while Iran retaliated by striking the Al-Azraq base in Jordan. Brent crude surpassed $100/barrel as the Persian Gulf conflict disrupts energy markets. Hamas military chief Fai Hamad was killed in a Gaza airstrike as IDF operations continue across the theater.
key_points: US CENTCOM destroyed 10 Iranian tankers in the past week after IRGC launched ballistic missiles twice at US Navy ships, all attacks failing (Source: @shin_persian/9633).
Iran's IRGC attacked Al-Azraq air base in Jordan under code name 'Haider Karrar'; Syrian air defense intercepted some missiles over Arrab (Source: @VahidOnline/78288).
A Panama-flagged tanker carrying Iraqi fuel oil was struck by a drone in Iraqi territorial waters; fire extinguished, no casualties (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6972).
Hamas military wing chief Fai Hamad was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Gaza City (Source: @yediotnews25/134860).
IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three weapons warehouses and a rocket launch pad in Gaza, seizing rockets and Kalašnikovs (Source: @almogboker78/18153).
IRGC-backed Houthi attacks on residential areas and displacement camps displaced thousands in Marib, Yemen (Source: @shin_persian/9637).
Brent crude reached $100/barrel for the first time since Mehr 2 amid ongoing Persian Gulf conflict (Source: @VahidOnline/78297).
IDF arrested three Palestinian officers who set up a barrier in C area near Beitunya and attacked an Israeli citizen (Source: @New_security8200/203720).

sections.executive_summary: US Central Command has destroyed 10 Iranian tankers in the past week following IRGC ballistic missile attacks on American warships, all of which failed to hit their targets. Iran retaliated by striking the Al-Azraq air base in Jordan and reportedly the Jask area, marking a dangerous expansion of the conflict beyond the Persian Gulf. The disruption to energy markets is acute, with Brent crude surpassing $100/barrel as maritime security deteriorates.
iran: IRGC launched ballistic missiles twice at US Navy warships in the Persian Gulf over two days; all attacks failed and no American forces were harmed. CENTCOM subsequently destroyed five IRGC tankers — M/T Kaviz, M/T Charminar, M/T Horizon 1, and M/T Riesco in the Arabian Sea, plus M/T Derya near Kharg Island (Source: @VahidOnline/78286).

IRGC claimed to have struck two US Navy destroyers, but CENTCOM confirmed no warship was hit and all attacks failed. US forces destroyed 10 Iranian tankers total in the past week (Source: @shin_persian/9633).

IRGC attacked Al-Azraq air base in Jordan under code name 'Haider Karrar,' targeting a location described as housing fighter jets. Syrian air defense intercepted some missiles over the border city of Arrab (Source: @VahidOnline/78288).
IRGC media reported hearing an explosion in Jask on Wednesday evening, suggesting strikes on Iranian soil or facilities (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80621).

Iran is increasingly using cryptocurrencies like Tether and Bitcoin for cross-border trade as US sanctions restrict traditional financial channels; the central bank relaxed foreign-currency controls (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6970).
Iran's foreign ministry stated the IAEA referred Iran's nuclear file to the Security Council, claiming Iran committed no violations (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/390203).
Brent crude reached $100/barrel for the first time since Mehr 2 due to ongoing conflict in the Persian Gulf region (Source: @VahidOnline/78297).
israel: IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three weapons warehouses and a rocket launch pad in Gaza used by Hamas and PIJ during the war, seizing dozens of weapons including rockets and Kalašnikovs (Source: @almogboker78/18153).

IDF arrested three Palestinian officers who set up a barrier in C area near Beitunya and attacked an Israeli citizen; the security system classified this as a severe deviation (Source: @New_security8200/203720).
Israeli military aircraft were reported operating from the coast of northern Palestine (Source: @redlinkleb/41927).
An Israeli GLF5 Gulfstream V reconnaissance aircraft (registration 684, squawk 4533) was tracked at 15,175 ft over Palestine (Source: @redlinkleb/41931).

Palestinian sources report Hamas military wing chief Fai Hamad was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Gaza City; Hamad was among prisoners released in the 2011 Shalit deal (Source: @yediotnews25/134860).
IDF strikes were reported in Srobin, southern Lebanon (Source: @yediotnews25/134864).
A shooting incident was reported on Gamla Street in Tiberias; medical teams performed resuscitation on a critically wounded person (Source: @yediotnews25/134858).
gaza_west_bank: Hamas military wing chief Fai Hamad was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Gaza City; he was a senior figure released in the 2011 Shalit prisoner exchange (Source: @yediotnews25/134860).
IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three weapons warehouses and a launch pad in Gaza used by Hamas and PIJ, containing rockets, Kalašnikovs, and additional combat equipment (Source: @almogboker78/18153).

IDF arrested three Palestinian officers who established a barrier in C area near Beitunya and attacked an Israeli citizen; classified as a severe institutional deviation (Source: @New_security8200/203720).

A Palestinian youth was sentenced to 13 years in prison by the Lod District Court for killing Israeli woman Aisha Rabai by throwing a stone at her vehicle in the Rachel settlement area of the West Bank in 2018; ordered to pay 258,000 shekels in compensation (Source: @lelotsenzura/94341).
lebanon: Reports of IDF strikes in Srobin, southern Lebanon were published by Palestinian and Israeli media sources (Source: @yediotnews25/134864).
syria_iraq: A Panama-flagged tanker carrying Iraqi fuel oil was struck by a drone in Iraqi territorial waters on Wednesday; port officials confirmed the fire was extinguished with no casualties (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6972).
An Iranian tanker carrying approximately 2 million barrels of fuel oil was struck by a drone in Iraqi waters on Wednesday, according to Iraqi port officials (Source: @mamlekate/104419).
Syrian air defense intercepted some missiles fired from Iran over the border city of Arrab in Jordan (Source: @VahidOnline/78288).
A US P-8A surveillance aircraft was observed operating near the coast of Karachi, Pakistan (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/390197).
gulf_states: IRGC attacked Al-Azraq air base in Jordan under code name 'Haider Karrar,' targeting what was described as a fighter jet deployment location (Source: @VahidOnline/78288).
Israel reportedly requested Saudi Arabia's support; Pakistan is reportedly considering joining the conflict and attacking Houthi rebels in Yemen (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80612).
IRGC-backed Houthi attacks on residential areas and displacement camps displaced thousands in Marib, Yemen (Source: @shin_persian/9637).
UKMTO issued maritime security warning 130-26 for commercial shipping operations (Source: @shin_persian/9632).

Eight F-35A fighters from the 158th Fighter Wing (Vermont) departed RAF Lakenheath en route to the US, with KC-46A tanker support; four additional jets reportedly remain in the CENTCOM area (Source: @shin_persian/9630).
Trump stated that the US may resume negotiations with Iran after additional attacks, believing the Iran war will end directly after the midterm elections (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/390207).

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has escalated to direct Iran-US naval warfare in the Persian Gulf, with Iran's IRGC launching ballistic missiles at US warships and striking the Al-Azraq base in Jordan — a significant geographic expansion. Iran's use of cluster missiles and the reported explosion in Jask suggest both offensive and defensive strikes are occurring on Iranian territory. The Houthi campaign in Yemen, backed by IRGC, is displacing thousands and threatening regional stability further. Maritime security is deteriorating as evidenced by tanker drone strikes in Iraqi waters and UKMTO warnings.
sections.regional_response: Israel reportedly sought Saudi Arabian support while Pakistan is reportedly considering joining the conflict against Houthi rebels in Yemen, suggesting a broadening coalition. The US has deployed F-35s from Vermont to CENTCOM and is maintaining a naval presence in the Persian Gulf. Trump indicated negotiations may resume after additional attacks and that the war could end after midterm elections, suggesting a potential off-ramp. Iran's foreign ministry has pushed back against IAEA referrals to the Security Council.
sections.intelligence_notes: Satellite imagery over six years shows a clear construction surge at the suspected nuclear site at Mount Karaj, raising proliferation concerns (Source: @asafroz/53258). Iran is increasingly relying on cryptocurrency for cross-border trade to evade sanctions (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6970). A US P-8A surveillance aircraft was tracked near Karachi, indicating expanded US intelligence collection in the region. Israeli domestic political dynamics include allegations of foreign interference in elections and a fake news scandal involving a Palestinian senior figure in the UAE (Source: @amitsegal/64807).
